title: carpinus laxiflora var. fargesii
intro: Carpinus laxiflora var. fargesii, commonly known as Farges' hornbeam, is a plant species in the family Betulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Farges' hornbeam include soothing and calming effects on the nervous system, as well as a potential ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
